title: aperiodic-nuclear-quartet-category
description: The category generated by commutating. Objects: commutative nuclear squares (A, σ, Δ). Morphisms: Heyting homomorphisms preserving both nuclei. Each object has four corner-cells (A, Fix(σ), Fix(Δ), A*) corresponding to the four phase-cells of articulation. Aperiodicity is a theorem (nucleus-aperiodicity): fiberwise variation of (σ_t, Δ_t) across histories produces global aperiodicity.
